model_annotation: Figure 3 illustrates inter-annotator agreement on the sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values. It comprises two pie charts side by side for each category of data, annotated and unaannotated. In the annotated data pie chart, there are three slices representing the number of conversations categorized as ambiguous (0.0), moderately ambiguous (0.47), and very ambiguous (0.82). The corresponding percentages for these categories are 0.88, 0.46, and 0.24, respectively. The unaannotated data pie chart also has three slices, with percentages of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23 for the same respective ambiguity levels. Both pie charts use shades of blue to differentiate the categories, and minor segments are visually emphasized by a slight outline to distinguish them from the main, larger segments. There is a legend provided in the upper right corner of the figure, and percentage labels are included within each slice. The chart also includes an overall macro LF1 score on annotated data of 0.91 and a dual-agent model score of 0.90, indicating high accuracy in the agreement between different annotators and between annotators and the model's predictions.
